notes.content:
[u][b]FreeHolder Steam Alpha 1 Hotfix 9[/b][/u]

[i]7.24.2016[/i]

[b]Announcements[/b]

[i]Starting Food[/i]
You asked, we responded. All characters now begin with 6 Pickled Asparagus, 2 months' worth of normal meals, which should hopefully take the bite out of starting off. I haven't added any other resources because food essentially buys you the time to get the resources you want at the start. Let me know what you think.

[i]Upcoming Resource Management Improvements[/i]
In line with several requests to improve the system, I though I would make a general announcement that a master resource ledger and warehouse system are planned for implementation before the upcoming alpha. Within a week I should be coding at least the first stages of this. Stay tuned.

[i]False Bugs[/i]
I assume all bug reports to be of real bugs for the purposes of investigation. If, however, the bug is not repeatable and I see no signs in the code of anything wrong, it may be what I call a "false bug." This has to do with the way Unity handles the loading of null values. It soldiers on when some piece of code doesn't work, but some memory value has been altered or corrupted, which manifests in a later, non-repeatable bug. I call it false because although it is a real bug, its source is a previous error, so it generates a false trail. If you have reported a bug but have not seen it specifically crushed, you can probably assume that I have investigated and concluded it is a false bug. That doesn't mean I'm right, I just only have so much time. If it happens to you again, please attempt to establish context and steps to generate the bug, and I will check again.

[i]New Music[/i]
I haven't added any new music for a while. I added another song that can play randomly at any season called Arcadian Hills. It's a strange mix of modal and rennaisance sounds that I think sets a dreamy mood, in contrast to some of the more insistent themes in the game.


[b]Improved Features[/b]
-Added greataxe, greatmaul support. Only equippable by a warrior.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
-Market orders no longer remain completed when exiting market screen
-Market should no longer generate junk orders
-Goat mood mechanics now working properly
-Combat items list now has room for 2x as many scavenged items
-Terramancy now fully functional and no longer cancels mulch ability
-Right-click to back out of category on Fabrica no longer leaves item text on left
-Alternate characters no longer remain unselectable when exiting from crafting ledger

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
-All characters now additionally start with 6 pickled asparagus

[b]Music[/b]
-New villa/map song Arcadian Hills added

notes.content:
[u][b]FreeHolder Steam Alpha 1 Hotfix 7[/b][/u]

[i]7.15.2016[/i]

[b]Announcements[/b]

[i]Agent Revamp[/i]

All of the agent's basic skills are now completely and fully functional, including all the equipment craftable with the Thiefcraft skill. Opportunist now works properly and has been enhanced. Arms dealer now provides the proper bonus to black market contracts. In short, the Agent is now an even more attractive class option.

[i]Stealth[/i]

Furthermore, stealth is now functioning and available in combat. Any character capable of stealthing will automatically attempt to do so at the start of a round, against a group spot roll made by enemies. If successful, the character cannot be targeted. On their turn, they may either break stealth to perform a normal attack or attempt a stealth melee attack, which is a delayed attack that can be performed against any enemy on the battlefield. The enemy gets an additional personal chance to spot the attack. If spotted, the attack is totally canceled. If not, they will deliver an uncounterable attack with a very large hit bonus.

Stealth is fun, and probably a bit overpowered right now, so please enjoy it! I plan to add stealth enemies to even the playing field soon.

[i]Bug Reports[/i]

I just wanted to thank all our recent bug reporters, particularly MaskedChimp, for their help in making FreeHolder the best game it can be. Keep submitting reports and I will keep squashing the bugs!


[b]Alpha 2 Features[/b]
-Stealth implemented for player characters
-Agent Skill Thiefcraft items revised, updated, and functional

[b]Improved Features[/b]
-Added market hotkey, m. Use to open and close market view without shipping.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
-Agent skill Opportunist now functional

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
-Generally lowered the material cost of various items

-Added animated roman sprite to market

notes.content:
[u][b]FreeHolder Steam Alpha 1 Hotfix 6[/b][/u]

[i]7.13.2016[/i]

[b]Announcements[/b]

[i]New Character Ledger[/i]

This hotfix introduces a substantial feature which will be featured in the upcoming Alpha 2 release of FreeHolder - a totally revamped and more functional character screen. It features the ability to edit two characters at once, and take equipment directly from other characters, removing the annoying need to unequip and reequip tools. The 1,2,and 3 hotkeys will place that character on the leftmost character sheet, and the ` hotkey will close the screen, rather than having to click the x in the top right. We think you will find this to be a substantial improvement over the old screen - that being said, if certain commonsense additions that I have overlooked come to your mind, by all means let me know. 

[i]Adjusted Bribe Amounts[/i]

The census taker will now charge along a gentler sliding scale, allowing players to get further into the game with the same groups. The series is now 2,4,8,12,16,20,24... on for as long as you can possibly make the payments. This is not necessarily a reflection of the final game values, but represents our desire to open up the game for extended while we put the second section in place.

On this note, I don't have journal entries each year as you get past year 4. It will give the same text after this point. I haven't had much time for writing recently since I've been coding recently. I'll probably get these into the next hotfix or so, but I don't think I'm going to have anything past year 6 in any case. We'll see where development and testing take us.


[b]Alpha 2 Features[/b]
-New Character Ledger added.

[b]New Features[/b]
-Can now click and drag to move the view around on map view
-TAB key can now be used to switch between villa and town views.

[b]Improved Features[/b]
-Added re-choosing of class when kaius and lydia class up
-Camera now recenters over towns on map toggle

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
-Apprentice Smith skill fixed and improved
-Outlander skill fixed
-Water willow saplings is no longer possible during winter
-Removed ability to open character sheet during class change
-Removed negative ore, stone, and marble bugs
-Heat counter fixed and now updating in "real time"

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
-New more gradual bribe amounts
-Removed chainmail since iron is unavailable
-Changed scalemail, medium shield, and warmace to apprentice smith ability
-Added gladius and throwing axes to apprentice smith ability

[b]New Features[/b]
-Feeding ledger now displays frostbite chance and can toggle for auto-supply of firewood
-Added purge saves button to load game screen

[b]Improved Features[/b]
-Right-click to go back on menu choices from submenus
-Allow mouseover text on disabled submenu items
-Right-click to go back on feeding ledger meal size and herb selections

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
-Removed equipment icon persistence bug
-Fixed display of stone marble and copper with Artisan’s geomancy skill
-Tips button no longer breaks display if clicked on certain screens
-Stone pit issues with negative stone have been fixed
-Remove water action from frost crops
-Fixed carryover of parched crop status after drought

[b]Graphical Improvements[/b]
-Changed colors of selling text on market ledger for readability
-Slowed down XP popups for visibility
-Replace market buttons with print
